audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side read 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[N] read 'Brand' on all seven.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Brand on every row and every phases[N].why already describes Brand winning the stage; 51.64% over 122 games with a ranged poke pattern into a setup mage supports it. The difficulty label EVEN 5.5/10 stays — she is not a losing lane, she is a lane that leaves.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to Brand to match the content layer, the packet and the existing whys.

audit.why: Her level 6 is Weaver's Wall at 180/150/120s — a roam tool, not lane pressure, which is exactly what the page already says. Her real lane spike is worked ground plus Threaded Volley reaching a 3s cooldown at rank 5.
audit.corrected: Kept the spike text; added the 180s rank-1 R cooldown to the cooldown field so the roam timer is countable.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page names Seismic Shove as the thing to track but never states what it sets up, and breakdown.cooldowns held no number.
audit.why: Unraveled Earth's mines stun enemies that dash through them or are knocked through them. Brand has no dash, so the only way that stun ever lands on him is Seismic Shove (14/12.5/11/9.5/8s, 900 range) throwing him into the field. Deny the shove and the mines are only a slow. Brand's Q also needs an ablaze target to stun, so E leads.
audit.corrected: Stated the W-into-E chain with both cooldowns, and made the immobility point explicit.
sources: enemyKit W and E text and cooldowns

audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected in place; both bleed bullets rewritten to their own titles.

edits.before: - Taliyah Seismic Shove: matchup-defining — The shove into Unraveled Earth is her whole setup — sidestep it and the burst whiffs. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E-Q stun package has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Seismic Shove is 14s at rank 1, 8s maxed, and it is the only thing that can knock an immobile Brand into Unraveled Earth's mines for the stun. - Unraveled Earth is a flat 14s at every rank. - Weaver's Wall is 180s at rank 1, so count her roams. - Your R is 100s: it closes fights.

edits.after: If Taliyah opens the score her Weaver's Wall roams get funded — shove and track the map instead of dueling. After a second, farm with W-E clears and stay relevant as stun-burn peel.

edits.after: Her R is a wall, not damage — carry by standing where Seismic Shove cannot throw you into Unraveled Earth, then R the clump it gathers.
